timeline.text: Building one math card by hand meant timing every beat to the second, over and over.
The real timing lived inside a video component the overnight robot couldn't run — no browser, no network.
So I rewrote that logic in plain Python, using exact fractions, not rounded numbers.
It now checks its own math before anything renders, catching drift before a bad card ships.
The result lands on the exact same frame as the real thing: frame 2992, not 2991.
